svg.title: When a check of the app fails
svg.desc: A pull request runs the checks of this app alone, such as nextcloud, the end-to-end tests, or the step Checks of this project of scripts/check.sh. When one fails, its last step writes its explanation from .github/checks.project.toml into the summary of the check and as its annotation: what it found, why that matters and how to fix it. After the checks, the PR coach keeps one comment on the pull request with that explanation, also on a pull request from a fork. Where a command fixes what the check found, the fix bot commits the fix onto a branch of this repository and suggests it on a fork; otherwise the explanation tells the person what to do, and the next push runs the checks again.
